public.text: A reference element is treated as covered when at least one country element realises it. Binary coverage does not show partial functionality, geographic reach, population coverage, maturity, service quality, or actual use.
public.suggestedRevision: Introduce graded coverage measures including functional scope, population and geographic reach, operational status, conformance, data quality, governance maturity, and adoption.
